name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.chi_split_cartesian
statement:
theorem chi_split_cartesian (d : OEData G p) :
    (∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t), IsCartesianOver p (d.chi u y hy)) ∧
    (∀ {s : S} (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = s), d.reind (𝟙 s) y hy = y) ∧
    (∀ {s : S} (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = s), d.chi (𝟙 s) y hy = eqToHom (d.reind_id y hy)) ∧
    (∀ {s t r : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (v : t ⟶ r) (z : O) (hz : p.obj z = r),
      d.reind (u ≫ v) z hz = d.reind u (d.reind v z hz) (d.p_reind v z hz)) ∧
    (∀ {s t r : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (v : t ⟶ r) (z : O) (hz : p.obj z = r),
      d.chi (u ≫ v) z hz = eqToHom (d.reind_comp u v z hz)
        ≫ d.chi u (d.reind v z hz) (d.p_reind v z hz) ≫ d.chi v z hz)

    (hy : p.obj y = t) : (m.liftOverIso u hx hy).hom = m.liftOver u.hom hx hy

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.liftOverIso_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftOverIso_inv {s t : S} (u : s ≅ t) {x y : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) : (m.liftOverIso u hx hy).inv = m.liftOver u.inv hy hx

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.liftOver_comp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem liftOver_comp {s t r : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (v : t ⟶ r) {x y z : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) (hz : p.obj z = r) :
    m.liftOver u hx hy ≫ m.liftOver v hy hz = m.liftOver (u ≫ v) hx hz

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.liftOver_comp_eqToHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftOver_comp_eqToHom {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) {x y y' : O} (h : y = y')
    (hx : p.obj x = s) (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    m.liftOver u hx hy ≫ eqToHom h = m.liftOver u hx ((congrArg p.obj h).symm.trans hy)

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.liftOver_congr
statement:
theorem liftOver_congr {s t s' t' : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (hs : s = s') (ht : t = t') {x y : O}
    (hx : p.obj x = s) (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    m.liftOver u hx hy
      = m.liftOver (eqToHom hs.symm ≫ u ≫ eqToHom ht) (hx.trans hs) (hy.trans ht)

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.liftOver_eqToHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftOver_eqToHom {s t : S} (hst : s = t) {x y : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) (hxy : x = y) :
    m.liftOver (eqToHom hst) hx hy = eqToHom hxy

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.liftOver_eq_iff
statement:
theorem liftOver_eq_iff {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) {x y : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) (f : x ⟶ y) :
    m.liftOver u hx hy = f ↔ eqToHom hx ≫ u ≫ eqToHom hy.symm = p.map f

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.liftOver_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftOver_id {s : S} {x : O} (hx : p.obj x = s) :
    m.liftOver (𝟙 s) hx hx = 𝟙 x

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.liftOver_map
statement: @[simp] theorem liftOver_map {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) : m.liftOver (p.map f) rfl rfl = f

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.obj_eq_iff
statement: theorem obj_eq_iff {x y : O} : x = y ↔ p.obj x = p.obj y ∧ m.coord x = m.coord y

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.p_act
statement: @[simp] theorem p_act (x : O) (g : G) : p.obj (m.act x g) = p.obj x

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.p_base
statement: @[simp] theorem p_base (s : S) : p.obj (m.base s) = s

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.p_e_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem p_e_symm (s : S) (g : G) : p.obj (m.e.symm (s, g)) = s

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.p_map_actFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem p_map_actFunctor_map (g : G) {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    p.map ((m.actFunctor g).map f)
      = eqToHom (m.p_act x g) ≫ p.map f ≫ eqToHom (m.p_act y g).symm

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.p_map_liftOver
statement:
@[simp] theorem p_map_liftOver {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) {x y : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    p.map (m.liftOver u hx hy) = eqToHom hx ≫ u ≫ eqToHom hy.symm

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.toMinSpec_act
statement: @[simp] theorem toMinSpec_act (x : O) (g : G) : d.toMinSpec.act x g = d.act x g

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.toMinSpec_actFunctor
statement: theorem toMinSpec_actFunctor (g : G) : d.toMinSpec.actFunctor g = d.actFunctor g

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.toMinSpec_base
statement: @[simp] theorem toMinSpec_base (s : S) : d.toMinSpec.base s = d.base s

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.toMinSpec_coord
statement: @[simp] theorem toMinSpec_coord (x : O) : d.toMinSpec.coord x = d.coord x

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.toMinSpec_e_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem toMinSpec_e_apply (x : O) : d.toMinSpec.e x = (p.obj x, d.coord x)

statement:

statement: theorem toOEData_actFunctor (g : G) : m.toOEData.actFunctor g = m.actFunctor g

@[simp] theorem toOEData_actHom {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : G) :

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_base
statement: @[simp] theorem toOEData_base (s : S) : m.toOEData.base s = m.base s

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_chi
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOEData_chi {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    m.toOEData.chi u y hy = m.liftOver u (m.p_e_symm s (m.coord y)) hy

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_chi_unique
statement:
theorem toOEData_chi_unique {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t)
    (f : m.toOEData.reind u y hy ⟶ y)
    (hf : p.map f = eqToHom (m.toOEData.p_reind u y hy) ≫ u ≫ eqToHom hy.symm) :
    f = m.toOEData.chi u y hy

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_coord
statement: @[simp] theorem toOEData_coord (x : O) : m.toOEData.coord x = m.coord x

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_isFull
statement: theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_isFull (m : MinSpec G p) : m.toOEData.isFull = m.full

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_ltrans
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOEData_ltrans (a : G) (x : O) :
    m.toOEData.ltrans a x = m.liftOver (𝟙 (p.obj x)) rfl
      ((m.p_act (m.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.coord x)).trans (m.p_base (p.obj x)))

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_ltrans_inv
statement:
theorem toOEData_ltrans_inv (a : G) (x : O) :
    m.toOEData.ltrans a x
        ≫ m.liftOver (𝟙 (p.obj x))
          ((m.p_act (m.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.coord x)).trans (m.p_base (p.obj x))) rfl
      = 𝟙 x ∧
    m.liftOver (𝟙 (p.obj x))
          ((m.p_act (m.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.coord x)).trans (m.p_base (p.obj x))) rfl
        ≫ m.toOEData.ltrans a x
      = 𝟙 (m.act (m.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.coord x))

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_ltrans_unique
statement:
theorem toOEData_ltrans_unique (a : G) (x : O)
    (f : x ⟶ m.toOEData.act (m.toOEData.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.toOEData.coord x))
    (hf : p.map f = eqToHom (((m.toOEData.p_act (m.toOEData.base (p.obj x))
        (a * m.toOEData.coord x)).trans (m.toOEData.p_base (p.obj x))).symm)) :
    f = m.toOEData.ltrans a x

statement:
theorem toOEData_reind {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t) :

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_toMinSpec
statement: theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.MinSpec.toOEData_toMinSpec (m : MinSpec G p) : m.toOEData.toMinSpec = m

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.coord_base_eq_one
statement: theorem coord_base_eq_one (d : OEData G p) (s : S) : d.coord (d.base s) = 1

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.coordinate_identities
statement:
theorem coordinate_identities (d : OEData G p) :
    (∀ s, d.coord (d.base s) = 1) ∧
    (∀ x h, d.coord (d.act x h) = d.coord x * h) ∧
    (∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),
      d.reind u y hy = d.act (d.base s) (d.coord y) ∧ d.coord (d.reind u y hy) = d.coord y) ∧
    (∀ x a b, d.act x a = d.act x b → a = b)

statement: @[simp] theorem rebase_act (d : OEData G p) (c : G) : (d.rebase c).act = d.act

@[simp] theorem rebase_actHom (d : OEData G p) (c : G) {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : G) :

statement:
@[simp] theorem rebase_base (d : OEData G p) (c : G) (s : S) :

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.rebase_chi
statement:
theorem rebase_chi (d : OEData G p) (c : G) {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O)

statement:
@[simp] theorem rebase_coord (d : OEData G p) (c : G) (x : O) :

statement:

statement: theorem rebase_one (d : OEData G p) : d.rebase 1 = d

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.rebase_rebase
statement:
theorem rebase_rebase (d : OEData G p) (c c' : G) :

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.OEData.rebase_reind
statement:
theorem rebase_reind (d : OEData G p) (c : G) {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) : (d.rebase c).reind u y hy = d.reind u y hy

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.baseChange_twistFactor_mul
statement:
theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.baseChange_twistFactor_mul {H : Type*} [Group H] (θ : H →* MulAut G) (c : G)
    (A B : H) : c * θ (A * B) c⁻¹ = (c * θ A c⁻¹) * θ A (c * θ B c⁻¹)

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.coord_eq_of_base
statement:
theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.coord_eq_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (x : O) :

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.eq_rebase_of_base
statement:
theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.eq_rebase_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    (hreind : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),

      d'.reind u y hy = d.reind u y hy) :

theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.liftFunctor_rebase (d : OEData G p) (c : G) (A : S ⥤ S) :

statement:
theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.liftFunctorθ_eq_conj_of_base (d d' : OEData G p)

    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.liftFunctorθ_eq_of_base
statement:
theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.liftFunctorθ_eq_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.liftFunctorθ_obj_eq_of_base
statement:
theorem Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.liftFunctorθ_obj_eq_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) (x : O) :
    d'.act (d'.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (θ (d'.coord x))

name: Tengoku.ObserverEquivarianceLean.liftFunctorθ_rebase

      (∀ (s : SingleObj Γ) (g : G), holCoord (holAct (holBase s) g) = g)) ∧

theorem prodBG_map_eq_of_eq (E : S × SingleObj G ⥤ C) {s₁ s₂ s : S} (h₁ : s₁ = s) (h₂ : s₂ = s)
    (f : s₁ ⟶ s₂) (hf : f = eqToHom (h₁.trans h₂.symm)) (c r : G) (hc : c = r) :
    E.map ((f, c) : (s₁, SingleObj.star G) ⟶ (s₂, SingleObj.star G))
      = eqToHom (congrArg (fun t => E.obj (t, SingleObj.star G)) h₁)
        ≫ E.map ((𝟙 s, r) : (s, SingleObj.star G) ⟶ (s, SingleObj.star G))
